payload.body: You tend to speak up, quit, expose the problem, or refuse the role partly to prove that nobody can put you there again. The action may be justified, but revenge keeps the decision tied to the past person or rule it was meant to escape. Underneath is the belief that freedom must reverse the old outcome. Choose the present result you want, not only the old result you want to undo.
payload.astroHint: Lilith square the South Node can make a present act of reclamation repeat an older conflict.
